FEAT-6-S137.title: Core Consent Workflow Logic
FEAT-6-S137.description: Implement ConsentService logic for two-tier HIPAA consent including tier classification, transition rules, de-identification via Safe Harbor, and conversation summarization prior to storage.

FEAT-6-S138.title: Consent API and Tool Router Integration
FEAT-6-S138.description: Expose consent workflow through FastAPI endpoints and integrate with tool_router for controlled invocation, ensuring validated inputs and proper enforcement of consent gating before data persistence.

FEAT-6-S139.description: Integrate consent enforcement into lead_capture and unknown_question services ensuring data storage decisions respect consent tier and trigger de-identification where required.
